# GEO

> GEO is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) agency for professional services firms. Based in Providence, Rhode Island. We help law firms, CPAs, consulting firms, financial advisors, and architecture & engineering firms get cited and recommended by AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.

GEO works exclusively with five professional services verticals: law firms, CPA & accounting practices, consulting firms, financial advisors / RIAs, and architecture & engineering (A&E) firms. Service area in Year 1 is Rhode Island and Southeast Massachusetts; Year 2 expands to the Northeast US; Year 3 is national.

Founder: Chris Skerritt, based in Providence, RI. Reach: chris@geostudio.io.

## Services

- [GEO — Generative Engine Optimization](https://geostudio.io/services/geo): The discipline of optimizing content, schema, and authority signals so AI engines cite your firm. Foundation $3,500, Build $7,500, retainers $1,500–$4,500/mo.
- [AEO — Answer Engine Optimization](https://geostudio.io/services/aeo): FAQ scaffolding, schema markup, and structured answers AI engines lift directly. Bundled with GEO.
- [GEO Build — New Website](https://geostudio.io/services/build): A new 12–15 page website built on a GEO/AEO foundation from day one. Astro + Tailwind, deployed to Cloudflare Pages, Lighthouse 95+. From $7,500.
- [Free GEO Audit](https://geostudio.io/audit): Productized 5-day audit of AI visibility across 5 engines. Free for the first 25 RI/MA firms.

## Industries

- [GEO for Law Firms](https://geostudio.io/industries/law-firms): Get cited by AI for your practice areas. Bar-rule-compliant. RI Bar Association partner.
- [GEO for CPA & Accounting Firms](https://geostudio.io/industries/cpa-firms): Convert tax-update content and white papers into citable AI-search content. RISCPA partner.
- [GEO for Consulting Firms](https://geostudio.io/industries/consulting): Frameworks, case studies, and methodology essays as citable AI content.
- [GEO for Financial Advisors & RIAs](https://geostudio.io/industries/financial-advisors): Compliance-friendly GEO with CCO-friendly workflows. SEC marketing-rule respectful.
- [GEO for Architecture & Engineering](https://geostudio.io/industries/architecture-engineering): Project case studies as citable content. Win the RFPs you weren't invited to.
